title: Omega Bio-tek Mag-Bind Environmental DNA 96 Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Perform manual steps 1‑13
steps.instruction: Carry out the first 13 steps of the Mag‑Bind® Environmental DNA Soil Protocol manually as described in the kit manual before using the OT‑2.

steps.title: Prepare Master Mix 2
steps.instruction: Combine XP1 Buffer and Mag‑Bind® Particles RQ to create Master Mix 2, which will be used by the OT‑2 starting at step 14.

steps.title: Configure deck and labware
steps.instruction: Place the following on the OT‑2 deck according to the deck map: Temperature Module (GEN2), Magnetic Module (GEN2), NEST 2 mL 96‑Well Deep‑Well Plate, NEST 96‑Well 100 µL PCR Full‑Skirt Plate, Opentrons 96‑well Aluminum Block, NEST 12‑Well 15 mL Reservoirs, Opentrons 300 µL Tips, Opentrons 200 µL Filter Tips, and the P300 8‑Channel Electronic Pipette (GEN2).

steps.title: Upload protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol .py file, unzip it if necessary, and upload it to the OT‑2 App. If custom labware is required, upload the corresponding .json files via More > Custom Labware > Add Labware.

steps.title: Calibrate deck and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the P300 8‑Channel pipette according to the provided calibration instructions.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT‑2 App; the robot will perform steps 14 onward, adding Master Mix 2 (XP1 Buffer + Mag‑Bind® Particles RQ) and completing the automated portion of the Mag‑Bind Environmental DNA 96 Kit workflow.
